limitations: Synthetic values and hot projection inputs; warm probe reuses one state pool in L2.
Cold probe rotates all 63 state and coefficient pools; its latency exceeds in-model latency.
NCU uses cache flush and no clock override; requested L1 sectors are not physical DRAM bytes.
The assistant fixture is bounded supplementary performance evidence, not broad quality qualification.
The corpus continuation repeats near its tail; its MTP acceptance does not represent assistant workloads.
Chunked prefill is unchanged; its variation is not counted as another Prefill gain.
Final incremental 2K-64K sweeps and the token-level MTP state gate are recorded separately.
Ordinary assistant paired gains are +0.656%, +1.251%, -0.342%; median gain does not establish a uniform gain or speed equivalence.
